items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by injecting malicious code into Magento's template system. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this zero-day, which has been actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update addresses multiple critical and important vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover. Exploitation could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, part of APSB26-92, allows an unauthenticated attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges. It has a CVSS score of 9.1 and requires no administrator privileges or user interaction.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored XSS vulnerability, included in APSB26-92, could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: This high-severity stored XSS vulnerability, addressed in APSB26-92, could lead to arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B, part of APSB26-92, could enable a security feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability, included in APSB26-92, could enable a security feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability, part of APSB26-92, could enable a security feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: This low-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability, addressed in APSB26-92, could result in privilege escalation. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.
